recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Do not restore the older broad role value set solely for this issue; the durable FHIR-20536 requirement is the DICOM mapping distinction, and current build-scope source already has it.
issue_request: FHIR-20536 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core AuditEvent, voted 5-0-0 by Security on 2019-04-02 and applied for R5. It requested clarification that DICOM AuditMessage RoleIDCode values map with all RoleIDCode values in AuditEvent.agent.role and one selected RoleIDCode from the type value set in AuditEvent.agent.type.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by John Moehrke's April 2019 Security pull request, merged as 3845b72a87c656d50824c09d6f28550fbe5c4d86. The old AuditEvent spreadsheet changed agent.type from a generic RoleIdCode mapping to prime RoleIdCode and changed agent.role to all RoleIdCode. The January 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 migrated those mappings into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists auditevent=AuditEvent, so source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml is current build-scope source. Current source keeps agent.type mapped to prime RoleIdCode and agent.role mapped to all RoleIdCode. AuditEvent.agent.type is bound to participation-role-type, which includes the DICOM CID 402 RoleIDCode value set. Later issues including FHIR-24908, FHIR-32453, FHIR-32520, and the already-reconciled FHIR-53882 changed DICOM terminology sourcing and type/role definitions or bindings, but did not reverse the FHIR-20536 mapping distinction.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative AuditEvent StructureDefinition already communicates that the primary or selected DICOM RoleIDCode maps to agent.type and all RoleIDCode values map to agent.role. Adding redundant prose would risk conflicting with later Security WG decisions that keep agent.role open with an example structural-role binding.
